data: What is the F1 score of the orange line after 120 epochs?

The orange line represents the F1 score for the model trained with 50% of the original training set. To find the F1 score of the orange line after 120 epochs, I need to look at the y-axis value corresponding to the orange line at the 120 epochs mark on the x-axis. The orange line reaches approximately 0.78 on the y-axis after 120 epochs. Therefore, the F1 score of the orange line after 120 epochs is approximately 0.78.
